rules.rule: Use upstream-first LE architecture: codec aggregate driver + SoundWire transport split + shared helper libraries.
rules.source_validation: WCD-FAMILY-RULE-001 validated by WCD939x transfer delta (+18.98 overall score, improved lifecycle/include metrics).
rules.anti_misuse_guardrail: Architecture guidance cannot justify LA-near-copy; anti-copy verifier warnings must remain zero or explicitly waived.

rules.rule: Use LA as content donor and LE as structure/reference pattern; never copy LA structure verbatim.
rules.source_validation: Transfer comparison showed quality gain with LE framing but elevated downstream derivation risk in Variant 1.
conditions: Reject conversion chunks with downstream similarity warnings above verifier warn threshold.
rules.anti_misuse_guardrail: Block LA-heavy bulk carryover even when score increases.

rules.rule: Keep LE target files hidden until scoring/gate stage in controlled reconstruction experiments.
rules.source_validation: WCD939x transfer validation enforced hidden-target protocol successfully for both variants.
rules.anti_misuse_guardrail: Any pre-scoring access to LE target invalidates experiment result.

rules.rule: Require multi-file lineage coverage for converted codec, SDW, and header files.
rules.source_validation: Both transfer variants reached 100% lineage coverage with deterministic artifact traceability.
rules.anti_misuse_guardrail: No PASS/WARN verdict accepted when lineage coverage is below threshold.

rules.rule: Preserve SoundWire RX/TX split structure in LE style and treat identity tuple finalization as runtime-evidence gated.
rules.source_validation: WCD938x learning pattern plus WCD9378 fail-closed blockers and evidence checklist.
conditions: Identity tuple claims require dmesg/sysfs evidence IDs.
rules.anti_misuse_guardrail: Never infer SDW numeric identity from sibling codec values.

rules.rule: Use LE regmap/regcache lifecycle patterns but keep paging/controller assumptions fail-closed until runtime traces.
rules.source_validation: WCD938x soundwire/regmap lifecycle audit plus unresolved WCD9378 paging/controller blockers.
conditions: Cache/sync transitions must be traceable in runtime evidence for final claim.
rules.anti_misuse_guardrail: Do not treat static regcache correctness as proof of paged-register runtime behavior.

rules.rule: Map DAPM widgets/routes/controls with topology evidence and penalize name-only cloning.
rules.source_validation: Transfer Variant 1 improved DAPM metrics significantly but also raised derivation risk warnings.
conditions: DAPM mapping sheet required per file.
Anti-copy verifier report required for DAPM-heavy patches.
rules.anti_misuse_guardrail: Reject DAPM inflation that depends on LA near-copy.

rules.rule: Reuse MBHC/Class-H shared libraries while keeping codec-specific Class-H base/version decisions fail-closed.
rules.source_validation: WCD938x LE integration accepted shared MBHC/Class-H pattern; WCD9378 blockers keep Class-H specifics unresolved.
conditions: Class-H address/base claims require hardware register traces.
rules.anti_misuse_guardrail: Do not add codec-specific Class-H behavior based on sibling codec assumptions.

rules.rule: Reject reset-in-hw_params and ad-hoc runtime recovery workarounds in conversion outputs.
rules.source_validation: WCD9378 and WCD938x learning both identify these patterns as unsafe and non-upstream.
rules.anti_misuse_guardrail: Any workaround-like reset/re-enumeration logic requires explicit runtime waiver and PM approval.

rules.rule: Enforce vendor include/API elimination with explicit replacement mapping to LE frameworks.
rules.source_validation: Variant 1 regression shows this rule is mandatory but must be guarded by measurable thresholds.
conditions: Block if VENDOR_ELIMINATION score regresses materially.
rules.anti_misuse_guardrail: High function score cannot override vendor-elimination regression.

rules.rule: Run anti-copy/anti-derivation checks and treat downstream warning findings as governance risk.
rules.source_validation: Variant 1 governance WARN was driven by DOWNSTREAM_REUSE_RISK and DERIVATION_RISK warnings.
conditions: Confidence downgrade or verdict penalty when downstream warnings are present.
rules.anti_misuse_guardrail: No promotion of LA-heavy strategy without adversarial anti-copy review.

rules.rule: Separate DTS/schema normalization from runtime proof; keep evidence checklists explicit and executable.
rules.source_validation: WCD9378 checklist and learning-impact updates improved replayability and hardware handoff quality.
conditions: Checklist items must include command, output artifact, and acceptance criteria fields.
rules.anti_misuse_guardrail: DTS normalization completion is not runtime readiness.

rules.rule: Runtime-sensitive decisions must remain fail-closed until evidence artifacts explicitly unblock them.
rules.source_validation: Validated in WCD9378 learning-impact and WCD939x transfer PM verdicts.
conditions: Verifier must block blocker-state transitions without linked runtime evidence artifact IDs.
rules.anti_misuse_guardrail: No runtime success claims from compile/gate signals alone.
